messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "rhinoceros", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large stocky quadruped shown in side view facing right, with the long shaggy brown fur, massive body, thick limbs with clawed paws, broad furry head and small rounded ears of a bear, a single long slender upcurved black horn rising from its nose, and a large glossy dark-brown domed shell covering the entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump, divided into a smooth shoulder shield and a larger ridged rear dome with a rim of small rectangular marginal plates.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a brown bear's head with furry muzzle, dark eyes and pale snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "a long curved black rhinoceros horn", "part": "horn", "where": "on the nose"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "a glossy dark-brown domed beetle-like carapace with longitudinal ridges and a rim of small plates, divided into a front shield and rear dome", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from the shoulders to the rump"}, {"looks_like": "long shaggy brown bear fur", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, body and legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
